questions.prompt: GTA 6's map seemingly leaked at a merch drop event tonight — the streets of Leonida spilling out early, and everyone's passing the screenshots around. Which scene sounds most like yours right now?

options.text: Already tracing every leaked street — I'm in Leonida before the game even opens.
Sitting with it, letting the new streets sink in slow.
My head's bouncing from leak to leak — too much map to take in at once.
One careful look, then I put it down — saving the real exploring for launch.

questions.prompt: Xbox just announced Wolfenstein 3 — a new fight on the horizon tonight, and the trailer's got everyone talking. When a new war story calls, where does it pull you?

options.text: Straight in — aim steady, ready for the next mission.
Easing in slow — the announcement can breathe, I'll get there when I get there.
Swept along with the hype — the trailer decides where tonight goes.
Head full of questions — what if it can't live up to the last one?

questions.prompt: You'd planned a quiet night in — then the news lands that A New Hope is coming back to IMAX in 70mm, and suddenly everyone's making plans. What do you do?

options.text: Start planning the trip — the big screen's worth rearranging the night for.
Hold steady — I'll see it when I see it, the film's waited this long.
Grumble about the hype — everyone's suddenly a Star Wars expert tonight.
Stay in — the couch and the quiet win over the crowd tonight.

questions.prompt: Deadpool and Wolverine just got a surprise credit on Avengers: Doomsday — the reveal nobody saw coming, and everyone's talking about it tonight. If someone handled the reveal-night drink for you, what would you want in your hand?

options.text: A cold lemonade — sweet, slow, made for a long night of theories.
Something sparkling and cold — easy sipping while the theories fly.
Virgin or hard — a Moscow mule hits just right tonight.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Duran Duran's drummer just stepped away — tinnitus, the sound itself catching up with him after all these years. Tonight, which sound is the sound of that beat going quiet for you?

options.text: A low, fading drumbeat — the rhythm easing out slow.
Just the quiet — no music tonight, only the room itself.
Friends talking it over — the songs are better when they're shared.
The old hits turned up loud — the band's beat still going strong.

questions.prompt: Three inductees are refusing to show up to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame ceremony — the stage set, the chairs empty, the music still playing. The next hour is yours before the ceremony starts. What should it feel like?

options.text: Loud and proud — the music's the point, the empty chairs can wait.
Steady and easy — I'll take the songs and leave the ceremony to itself.
Wandering easy — the hour's mine, the speeches can wait.
Restless — too many speeches, too many names, too much noise.
